1. (Currently amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; __a fan; and an air outlet positioned to direct cooled air into an interior space__.

2. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced about sixteen inches on center.

3. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced about twenty-four inches on center.

4. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, __and wherein the fan draws air through the moistened pad__.

5. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation.

6. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening.

7. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation __through a return path within the housing__.

8. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the water reservoir is filled with additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below a predetermined level.

9. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 8, further including a ball float valve that opens to fill the water reservoir with the additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below the predetermined level.

10. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, further including a water drain.

11. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover __that is removable for access to internal components__.

12. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.

13. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall __of a residential structure__.

14. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the structure is a garage.

15. (Currently amended) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements __configured to secure the housing between the pair of studs__; and a ventilation grill.

16. (Previously presented) The cooling system kit of claim 15, further including instructions.

17. (Currently amended) A cooling system, comprising: in a __housing for mounting__ within a structure wall, __an evaporative cooling assembly for__ evaporatively cooling an indoor area.

18. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the __housing for mounting__ includes placing the __evaporative cooling assembly__ between wall studs spaced about sixteen inches on center.

19. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the means for mounting includes placing the means for evaporatively cooling within a structure wall, the structure wall constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF).

20. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the means for enclosing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.
